newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee stronger vs dollar and sterling.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee stronger vs dollar and sterling.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened against both the dollar and pound on Wednesday, foreign exchange dealers at commercial banks said.
The rupee was at a mean commercial rate of 20.1465 to the dollar, from 20.2320 on Tuesday. The rupee strengthened to a mean of 33.125 to one pound stg, from 33.991 on Tuesday.
The dealers said the dollar rate on Wednesday reflected both the U.S. currency's trend in international markets overnight and a central bank intervention on Tuesday.
The central bank sold $400,000 to commercial banks on Tuesday at 20.12 rupees for one dollar, one dealer said.
The dealer said the central bank intervened again late on Wednesday morning, selling dollars at 20.07 rupees. The amount sold in this intervention was not yet available.
"The interbank (forex) market is dead calm as the banks now prefer to wait for the interventions, where they can get dollars at lower rates," the dealer said.
